description: Wake up to the sound of the waves and enjoy coffee on your private balcony with stunning ocean views 🌊☕ This 2BR oceanfront condo on the 4th floor of a secure, gated building features an open layout filled with natural light. Relax by the oceanfront pool or step through the gate for direct beach access. Perfect for a peaceful getaway or weekend escape with unforgettable sunsets right from your balcony 🌴The spaceThe Space, modern, chic two-bedroom, one-bathroom condo is located on the 4th floor of a secure, gated building with one assigned parking space. From the moment you open the front door, you're welcomed by stunning ocean views and an open floor plan designed for relaxation and connection.Enjoy a dip in the oceanfront pool while listening to the soothing sound of waves, or take just a few steps beyond the pool to access the sandy beach. For your convenience, we provide beach chairs, umbrella, towels, and a cooler—everything you need for a perfect beach day.The fully equipped kitchen has all the essentials, making it easy to prepare meals and enjoy them with the ocean as your backdrop. Drift to sleep each night to the calming sound of the waves, and wake up ready to soak in every moment of paradise.Guest accessGuests have full private access to the entire apartment, including:🛏️ Two bedrooms🚿 One bathroom🍽️ Fully equipped kitchen🛋️ Living room and dining area🌅 Private balcony with ocean view🧺 In-unit washer and dryerYou’ll also have access to:🏖️ Direct beach access🏊 Community pool🚗 One assigned parking space (additional street parking is available, but not guaranteed)🛗 Elevator access to the unitEverything listed is for your exclusive use, except for the pool and beach, which are shared within the gated communityOther things to noteAir Conditioning: Each bedroom has its own air conditioner to keep you cool and comfortable at night. The main living area does not have AC, but ceiling fans, and the ocean breeze help keep the space airy and pleasant. Many guests leave a bedroom door open with the AC on and fans running — it works well to cool the whole area during the day.Tropical Climate: This is Puerto Rico — it’s warm and humid year-round, especially in the afternoons. If you’re very sensitive to heat in shared spaces, just know this isn’t a fully air-conditioned home.Oceanfront Location: The view and breeze are beautiful — you’re steps from the ocean, which most guests love. Expect the natural sounds of waves and the occasional gust of salty air!Elevator Access: The unit is accessible by elevator — no stairs required.Parking: One assigned parking space is included with your stay. Additional street parking is usually available but can fill up, especially on weekends or holidays.Comfortable and Relaxed Vibe: This isn’t a hotel — it’s a laid-back, coastal getaway designed for travelers who want location, comfort and convenience

description: The Babanees is a quaint, boho surfer style home located in the heart of Puntas, Rincon. With over 20 windows inside, it makes for a beautiful airy space. Situated on the top of "Bummer Hill" the home has sweeping ocean views from almost every room. I have been working at hard rehabbing and the designing the space myself. This is a 3 bedroom, 1 bath, full equipped private home rental. Monthly prices are non-negotiable, what is quoted on Airbnb is the price. No pets & 30 day max bookingsThe spaceWelcome to The Babanees, a three-bedroom one-bath private house located in the heart of Puntas, Rincon. I took on the undertaking of rehabbing and redesigning the interior to reflect a boho surfer chic style. It’s a great space that holds a certain novelty that only a place like Rincon, PR could possess. The house has all brand new appliances. New stove, refrigerator, bath remodel, furniture, 50' screen TV with streaming capabilities, high-speed internet, and brand new inverter A/C. There are plenty of ocean views, light, and ventilation from the abundance of windows in the home. I have a reverse osmosis filter in the kitchen to ensure you are getting the cleanest and safest waterThe house has great wifi for working remotely. However, we do experience outages that are out of our control. If you rely on wifi to work, please bring a hotspot as a backupI have a 300-gallon backup gravity water cistern. Please keep in mind that the water does frequently go out in Puntas. House is equipped with an 1800 Watt Duracell Gas-less Lithium Battery Pack that is a generator. I do not have a whole house generator. The power pack is meant to keep a few lamps, a fan, and the refrigerator running when the power is out. Will sustain these items for around 12 hours. It is available to ensure that food does not spoil and you are not stuck in the dark. It is a safe, short-term option. There is a studio apartment attached to the lower back half of the house. It may be rented and can be rented separately if you need more space for the party. My goal is to keep making this home unique and fun. It's perfect for a couple, young family, or solo travelers who want a clean and cozy space to lay their heads while they explore the awesomeness of Rincon!There is an attached studio apartment at the back of the property.The cleaning fee is non-negotiable. A private cleaning service is used to ensure that house standards are met for all guests. Please do not ask to clean the house yourself. Come be my guest at The Babanees!Please reference the house rules and house manual section to agree upon my rental terms.oOther things to noteThe house has great wifi for working remotely. However we do experience outages that are out of our control. If you rely on wifi to work, please bring a hotspot as a backupThere is an attached apartment on the property. It has separate access to the back of the house. Both locations are separate, secure, and private. They are separate units, that do not share anything.NO PETS! Additionally, I have also had guests rescue dogs off the street, causing me undue stress during the reservation. Many of the rescues in Puerto Rico are strapped, meaning they will most likely not be able to help you, if you decide to take in a stray. They will tell you the responsibility is on YOU to vet the animal and get it off the island. I have rescued animals and fostered them in MY OWN home in PR & NY, but never would I rescue an animal in an Airbnb or a home that is not mine. Since I am about to become a new mother, I won't be able to foster for a while and don't need to be stressed out that you may not be able to truly give this animal the help it needs, or worse, have to put it back on the street before your vacation ends. Think about the consequences and/or contact a rescue before you help out a stray animal in Puerto Rico. I can offer up community resources to reach out to, but that's it. If you bring an animal, it must be a service dog and I will request documentation, along with a doctor's note that says your animal is a certified service animal- just like the Airlines do.There is a lovely, disabled family who lives behind our property. They are deaf. They have a dog that spends lots of time outside and has a dog house, additional shade, water, and food provided to him. This family loves the dog, and it belongs to their son. However, people from the states sometimes do not understand why the dog is kept outside. I have had guests harass the family and me about the dog. I will no longer tolerate neighbors who trespass into my neighbor's yard to try and get near the dog. The neighbors have cameras on their property. If you are caught trespassing on camera, we will notify the authorities, and it will be posted to your Airbnb review. ***If you think you will be bothered by a dog who spends lots of time outside in a dog house, please do not book my home.***

title: Sunset Hill, Rincón | Romantic Chalet & Tree House
description: Cozy house located on the hill of the Atalaya neighborhood of Rincón. From the accommodation you can enjoy an incredible panoramic view, where the best sunsets in the town of beautiful sunsets are captured. The place consists of two bedrooms, a living room, kitchen, bathroom, and a beautiful terrace on the roof of the house. One of the rooms has a private balcony, and from the kitchen you have access to a rustic balcony that allows fresh air into the house.The spaceThe house is ideal for couples and/or families with a maximum of 4 people. On the property's terrace you can enjoy different attractions such as the glass chalet for two and the tree house. Perfect for recharging your batteries on a new day, being captivated by the sunsets and enjoying a starry sky at night. On the way to the house you will find the gastronomic route with a wide variety of restaurants that you can visit during your stay. If you want to tour the town and its attractions, in less than 20 minutes by car you will find the coast of Rincón with beautiful beaches for all kinds of tastes, whether you want to sunbathe, have a day trip and/or do water sports such as surfing, diving, snorkeling, among others. In the center of town you will find city life with an ideal atmosphere for day and night enjoyment. In addition to having various tourist attractions to choose from every day, every Thursday we recommend the gallery nights held in the public square with a repertoire of talented local artisans.
